_about: T915 placeholder, filled by a later harvest. Per trail id (the trails wire id, as a string): {dogs?: "yes"|"leash"|"no", permit?: one short plain English sentence (a permit or fee the walk needs), huts?: {hut name exactly as in the detail file's huts[]: {season?: [fromMonth, toMonth], booking?: true|false}}, access?: {parking?: {name?, lat, lon, m, fee?: true|false, eur_day?}, transit?: [{name, mode: "bus"|"train"|"tram"|"ferry", lat, lon, m}]}, start?: {name?, lat?, lon?, ele?}}. A value here wins over the derived one, field by field. Keys starting with _ are notes and are never published. pipeline/outdoor/derive_outdoor_pages.py writes the detail file's keys. Mount Korab (63433, AL) is the worked example: no fact about dogs or a permit is checked yet, so it carries only a note.

63433._note: Mount Korab from Radomire. Fill dogs and permit when a source states them; the walk has no hut on the way, so huts stays empty.
